title: Tumhara weight 60 kg NAHI hai
description: Season 2 Episode 8: Mass is how much stuff you are (kg); weight is the force Earth pulls you with (newton) — and a weighing machine measures force.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 4 (mass vs weight, W = mg, apparent weight in a lift)
concept: Mass is how much stuff you are (kg); weight is the force Earth pulls you with (newton) — and a weighing machine measures force.
on_screen_cues: "MASS = 60 kg (everywhere)" → "WEIGHT = m × g = 600 N (Earth) · 100 N (Moon)" → lift: "up ↑ N > mg · down ↓ N < mg · free fall N = 0" → "NCERT XI Ch 4"
pinned_comment: Script 1 ka answer: girti lift mein JUMP karne se kuch nahi hota — tumhari jump 2–3 m/s ki hai, lift 100+ km/h pe gir rahi hai 😬. Ab batao: weighing machine pe kya dikhega jab lift UPAR jaate hue RUK rahi ho?
suggested_titles: "Tumhara weight 60 kg nahi hai!" / "Mass vs Weight — lift mein weight badalta hai?"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [confidently] Chintu, mera weight 60 kg hai.
Chintu: [deadpan] Wrong.
Gudiya: [sarcastic] Excuse me? Machine pe khud dekha!
Chintu: [cheerfully] 60 kg tumhara MASS hai. Weight nahi.
Gudiya: [confused] Dono same nahi hain?
Chintu: [excited] Mass matlab tumhare andar kitna "maal" hai. Woh Earth pe, Moon pe, space mein... har jagah 60 kg.
Gudiya: [curious] Aur weight?
Chintu: [excited] Weight woh FORCE hai jisse Earth tumhe kheenchti hai. Mass into g. 60 into 10... 600 NEWTON!
Gudiya: [surprised] Mera weight 600 Newton hai?!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Earth pe. Moon pe sirf 100 Newton. Mass wahi 60 kg, weight one-sixth!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Toh weighing machine kya maapti hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Force! Isliye lift mein try karo. Lift upar shuru ho... machine ZYADA dikhayegi!
Gudiya: [gasps] Sach?! Aur neeche jaate hue?
Chintu: [excited] Kam! Aur agar lift ki rassi toot jaaye...
Gudiya: [whispers] Zero... jaise astronaut!
Chintu: [elated] EXACTLY! Mass kabhi zero nahi hota. Weight ho sakta hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh ghoda gaadi ko kheenchta hai, gaadi ghode ko utna hi. Toh gaadi aage kaise jaati hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
